description: Helper functions for challenge submission, Microsoft profile and achievement verification, and base64 encoding/decoding.

methods.name: canSubmitCodeRoadCertProject
methods.description: Checks if a user can submit a CodeRoad project based on challenge completion.

methods.name: getMSProfile
methods.description: Fetches Microsoft profile data for a given username.

methods.name: verifyTrophyWithMicrosoft
methods.description: Verifies if a user has earned a specific Microsoft trophy.

methods.name: decodeFiles
methods.description: Decodes an array of base64-encoded file objects.

methods.name: decodeBase64
methods.description: Decodes a base64 string into UTF-8.

methods.name: encodeBase64
methods.description: Encodes a UTF-8 string into base64.
